lines.en: porter I arrived in London at last.
The railway station was big, black and dark.
I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
lines.zh: 我不知道去旅馆的路该怎么走，于是向一个搬运工打听。

lines.en: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
lines.zh: 我的英语讲得不但非常认真，而且咬字也非常清楚。

lines.en: The porter, however, could not understand me.
lines.zh: 然而搬运工却不明白我的话。

lines.en: I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.
lines.zh: 我把问话重复了很多遍。他终于听懂了。

lines.en: he answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
lines.zh: 他回答了，但他讲得既不慢也不清楚。

lines.en: Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him.
lines.zh: 于是他说得慢了，可我还是听不懂。

lines.en: My teacher never spoke English like that!
lines.zh: 我的老师从来不那样讲英语！

lines.en: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
Then he said something and I understood it.
lines.zh: 接着，他说了点什么，这回我听懂了。

lines.en: In England, each person speaks a different language.
lines.zh: 在英国，人们各自说着一种不同的语言。

lines.en: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them!
lines.zh: 英国人之间相互听得懂，可我却不懂他们的话！
